cohort: The study included 73 premature infants (32 of hypertensive mothers, 41 of normotensive mothers) less than 34 weeks' gestation (mean 29 weeks) who were on respiratory support.
finding: The evaluated airway inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers (MDA, NO, IL-8) were not increased in premature infants of hypertensive mothers and were not predictors of BPD/death, although premature infants who developed BPD/death had higher levels of IL-8 in the first days of life.
